company.shortDescription: Zudo.work provides AI agents that automate warranty customer calls, coverage verification, and technician dispatch.
company.description: Zudo.work provides AI agents for warranty administrators that automate customer support, sales, and authorization workflows. The platform focuses on home and auto warranty markets, handling high-volume service operations such as claims processing, coverage inquiries, and service authorizations. Its agents operate over voice and integrate with internal systems to manage customer calls, verify coverage, and dispatch technicians. Zudo.work also supports after-hours support scenarios, enabling autonomous handling of complex, contract-driven interactions. The product is designed for warranty obligors and third-party administrators seeking to streamline operationally intensive processes and improve consistency of customer interactions.
